tools.name: which_tool
tools.description: How to get data from one website: its official API (status, name, price and limits notes, docs, check date) beside the ranked catalogue tools (score, price per 1,000 results, core-field coverage, distinctive fields, page and Store link), plus robots.txt and terms facts. Optionally rank by the output

tools.name: find_by_field
tools.description: Catalogue tools whose published output schema includes the fields you need (e.g. ['email', 'phone'] or ['salary']), optionally for one website, cheapest first among equal matches.

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: The websites Scraper Finder maps, with their official API status and number of ranked tools. Filter by name, domain or category text, or by API status (public, limited, partner, none, retired).
